label: 2-Bar Swell
description: Gentle dynamic swell across a 2-bar arc: quiet at phrase start and end, loud in the middle. Good for sustained pads or slow harmonic progressions. Accent pattern adds a slight downbeat emphasis.

summary.curve_shape: swell — quiet → loud → quiet over 2 bars
summary.accent_pattern: downbeat accented at 1.5, other beats at 1.0
